audited_objective: Make Lunar Lake an excellent profile-aware local inference appliance with a reliable dense Qwen route, earned OpenVINO GPU/NPU route promotion, protected BitNet CPU reference behavior, strict regression, and explicit claim boundaries.
decision_reason: The committed evidence supports profile-aware operator readiness, strict regression v2, bounded dense Qwen CPU/OpenVINO quality evidence, profile-scoped route promotion, BitNet semantic-intake protection, post-VALIDATE-002 readiness indexing of low_power power-profile plus thermal temperature availability context, REG-011 route/model identity gating for route-profile and cold/warm benchmark evidence, OP-013 fail-closed default model resolution for blocked auto routes, OP-014 low_power blocked-ask runbook and next-evidence guidance, VALIDATE-003 readiness indexing of that blocked low_power ask receipt, POWER-009/#6097 power-profile indexing of the same runbook and telemetry-context --require-battery guidance with closeout #6099 merged, REG-012/#6102 strict-regression-surface fields for Arc/NPU bounded proof coverage with closeout #6103 merged, REG-013/#6106 strict-regression-surface fields for BitNet CPU reference route evidence with closeout #6107 merged, ASK-006/ASK-007 appliance-level auto ask receipts for ask_normal and ask_short, refreshed semantic-intake ledger recording formerly pending A770 shared BitNet semantic PRs #4756/#4757/#4767/#4853/#5064 as closed unmerged, and swarm A770 PR #43 as merged_to_main after the prior Lunar Lake cutoff, making semantic-intake stale with rerun_required=true and intake_ready=false until Lunar Lake BitNet reruns refresh evidence. POWER-007/POWER-008 runbook discoverability for the physical battery-mode low_power run, A770-005/#6072 selected-device OpenCL smoke closeout #6079, and A770-006/#6110 selected-device OpenCL matmul_i2s CPU parity closeout #6112 remain non-semantic adjacent accelerator evidence at the prior cutoff. The objective is not complete because low_power has no promoted route, current energy-proxy evidence is AC-only, battery-mode telemetry remains blocked by AC power, and thermal temperature readings remain unavailable. In swarm, SWARM-LNL258V-REG-001/#29 proved strict regress and compare against the migrated receipts with no content drift, and tracker closeout #32 recorded that native swarm proof in the campaign tracker. This audit remains not_complete because A770 #43 now requires Lunar Lake BitNet reruns and a live telemetry-context --require-battery preflight still reports AC power and cannot satisfy POWER-006.
